description: This Java source file defines an adapter class 'ThingErrorResponseAdapter' responsible for mapping 'ThingErrorResponse' objects to and from a more generic 'Adaptable' interface, enabling consistent error response handling within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter component.

classes.name: ThingErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class that adapts 'ThingErrorResponse' objects for protocol mapping, extending 'AbstractErrorResponseAdapter' and implementing 'ThingAdapter' for error response handling within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of 'ThingErrorResponseAdapter' with provided header translator and error registry.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Returns a 'TopicPathBuilder' configured based on the 'ThingEntityId' of the provided 'ThingErrorResponse'.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs a 'ThingErrorResponse' object using the given 'TopicPath', exception, and headers.
